v_velocity.name: Velocity Vector
v_velocity.description: The rate of change of position vector with respect to time.

v_speed.name: Scalar Speed
v_speed.description: The magnitude of the velocity vector.

m_mass.name: Mass
m_mass.description: Quantitative measure of an object's resistance to acceleration.

F_force.name: Force Vector
F_force.description: An interaction that, when unopposed, changes the motion of an object.

p_momentum.name: Linear Momentum
p_momentum.description: The product of the mass and velocity of an object.

E_energy.name: Total Energy
E_energy.description: The quantitative property that is transferred to a body to perform work.

K_kinetic_energy.name: Kinetic Energy
K_kinetic_energy.description: Energy that a body possesses by virtue of being in motion.

V_potential_energy.name: Potential Energy
V_potential_energy.description: Energy held by an object because of its position relative to other objects.

a_acceleration.name: Acceleration Vector
a_acceleration.description: The rate of change of velocity with respect to time.

t_time.name: Time
t_time.description: Independent variable representing duration or temporal coordinate.

r_position.name: Position Vector
r_position.description: Vector representing the location of a point relative to an origin.

x_displacement.name: Displacement / Position
x_displacement.description: Linear position coordinate along an axis or displacement from equilibrium.

k_spring_constant.name: Spring Constant (Stiffness)
k_spring_constant.description: Measure of the stiffness of a spring or restoring force according to Hooke's Law.

omega_angular_frequency.name: Angular Frequency
omega_angular_frequency.description: Rate of change of angular phase of a sinusoidal wave or simple harmonic oscillator.

g_gravitational_acceleration.name: Standard Gravitational Acceleration
g_gravitational_acceleration.description: Acceleration imparted to objects due to Earth's gravity (approx 9.81 m/s²).

L_angular_momentum.name: Angular Momentum
L_angular_momentum.description: Rotational analog of linear momentum, given by r × p.

W_work.name: Work
W_work.description: Energy transferred to or from an object via the application of force along a displacement.

c_speed_of_light.name: Speed of Light in Vacuum
c_speed_of_light.description: Universal physical constant equal to exactly 299,792,458 m/s.

G_gravitational_constant.name: Newtonian Constant of Gravitation
G_gravitational_constant.description: Empirical physical constant involved in the calculation of gravitational effects.

kB_boltzmann.name: Boltzmann Constant
kB_boltzmann.description: Physical constant relating the average kinetic energy of particles in a gas with temperature.
